verdict.rationale: three.js is a client-side JavaScript 3D rendering library with no hosted service that could emit outbound HTTP callbacks, so webhook event subscriptions are outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows a webhook capability that would make the axis applicable; the probes find no API surface (no OpenAPI), and its in-library event handling is not a registrable webhook.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
